Since, the problem looked like it might be from the unknown number of rows, I tried compute()ing the table and feeding the result in, but that did remove the error.  Nor did specifying chunk size in do, nor setting chunk size and adding n= -1.  I also tried setting    options(dplyr.show_progress = F) to no avail.
I was already planning on moving the logic over to postgre, and switching to using mutate, which may solve the problem, but I still find it odd that dplyr seems to fail in the progress bar.
